read_rule: Only existing listed paths plus own newly created files and this scope JSON; absent listed files do not grant alternative exploration.
forbidden: All other edits/reads, broad review/exploration, new independent tests, weakening assertions or protection; builds/tests/formatters/servers/install/commits/pushes/CI/graph rebuild/release/child agents.
deliverable: Fix only assigned concrete CI diagnostics and size violations while preserving behavior and assertions. Report files read/modified/created, decisions, acceptance symbols and unresolved out-of-scope requests, then stop.
acceptance: Same Root-owned complete remote RV1 suite, unchanged public contracts and all selected assertions; only static self-review in worker.
connected_surface_reason: Assigned callers, exact compiler-named definitions and their facade are one typed integration boundary; separating them would hide the required visibility/signature contract.

symbol_limits.native/src/share/core/legacy_direct_requ: authenticated_decision, Refusal and directly called helpers only
